name: Nemedians

attributes.attribute: left the family home in Scythia

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Nemedians are the people who followed the leader Nemed. They left the family home in Scythia. They migrated together to Ireland. Their journey forms part of the invasion tales of Ireland. Some scholars believe such myths carry faint memory of history now lost.

okr.objective: The Nemedians are the people of Nemed who migrated to Ireland.
